The name Aimee carries the meaning “Beloved” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. historical_references.reference: Aimee Semple McPherson, a prominent Canadian-American Pentecostal evangelist, was born on October 9, 1890 in Ingersoll, Ontario. She is best known for starting the Foursquare Church and her healing and faith-healing campaigns. Her ministry reached its peak in the 1920s and 1930s.

historical_references.reference: Aimee Dudley, an English nun and missionary, was born around 1475 in Lincolnshire. She is known for her devotion to St. Catherine of Siena and is believed to have saved Rome from the Turks in the early 1500s. She died in 1540.
